claim_tested: Does TAX-2 form a cGMP-gated channel and is the heteromer cGMP-selective?
key_finding: TAX-4/TAX-2 heteromer forms; 25-fold less cGMP-sensitive than TAX-4 homomer; remains highly selective for cGMP over cAMP; TAX-2 alone makes no channel
context: C. elegans subunits in human HEK293 cells
confidence_and_limits: High for the functional phenotype. Does not separate ligand binding at the TAX-2 site from allosteric coupling, and does not measure binding.

claim_tested: Which residues read cGMP in the nematode CNG alpha subunit?
key_finding: cGMP-bound open state of TAX-4; I computed 15 residues within 4.5 A of cGMP, including F558, G559, E560, S562, R574, R575, T576, A577 and C-helix I616/K619
context: C. elegans TAX-4 homomer in detergent/nanodisc
confidence_and_limits: High. It is TAX-4, not TAX-2; transfer to TAX-2 is by alignment.

claim_tested: How does cGMP binding couple to gating in TAX-4?
key_finding: Closed and open full-length TAX-4 structures in nanodiscs; cGMP binding produces global changes opening a cavity gate ~52 A away
confidence_and_limits: High for TAX-4 mechanism; again not TAX-2.

claim_tested: Does the vertebrate CNG beta subunit bind cGMP?
key_finding: In 7RHH chain B = CNGB1, cGMP is modelled and contacts F1028, G1029, R1042, T1043 (2.7 A), A1044; no C-helix contact
confidence_and_limits: High. Ligand modelling at moderate resolution; occupancy under saturating cGMP.

claim_tested: Which residue discriminates cGMP from cAMP and how?
key_finding: Neutralising a single Asp in the bovine rod CNG binding domain alters agonist selectivity; the effect is on allosteric efficacy, not on initial binding affinity
confidence_and_limits: High. Bovine CNGA1, not TAX-2; the residue maps to TAX-2 D663 by alignment.

claim_tested: How many beta subunits are in the native channel?
key_finding: Rod CNG channel is three CNGA1 plus one CNGB1
confidence_and_limits: High for vertebrates. Stoichiometry of TAX-4/TAX-2 in vivo is not established.

claim_tested: What does tax-2 encode and where does it act?
key_finding: tax-2 encodes a predicted CNG channel subunit in olfactory, gustatory and thermosensory neurons; TAX-2::GFP in sensory cilia and axons; axon outgrowth defects in mutants
confidence_and_limits: High for gene identity and expression. Sequence-level prediction only for the CNBD.

claim_tested: Is a predicted phosphorylation site on TAX-2 required for adaptation?
key_finding: A predicted PKG phosphorylation site on the beta subunit is required for short-exposure olfactory adaptation
confidence_and_limits: Moderate. I located the only canonical (R/K)(R/K)X(S/T) PKG motif in TAX-2 at S727, in the C-terminal tail outside the CNBD, so this bears on regulation, not pocket integrity.

claim_tested: Is the channel in AWC only TAX-4/TAX-2?
key_finding: CNG-3 forms a complex with both TAX-2 and TAX-4 in AWC; different subunit combinations have different physiology
confidence_and_limits: Moderate. Means heteromer composition in vivo may be more complex than a TAX-4/TAX-2 dimer of dimers.

claim_tested: Is the TAX-2 CNBD pocket canonical, degenerate or non-canonical?
key_finding: 11/15 cGMP-contact positions identical to TAX-4; full PBC (G605, E606, R618, T619) plus F604, S608, R617, A620 and C-helix D663 conserved; only K619N and three conservative changes; pocket columns significantly more constrained than the rest of the CNBD (p=7.4e-3 orthologs, p=1.7e-4 panel)
context: In silico, G5EEE2 vs 5H3O/7RHH and 5 nematode orthologs
confidence_and_limits: Moderate-high as inference. Alignment-based transfer; no experimental TAX-2 structure or binding measurement exists.

claim_tested: What is the current evidence basis for cGMP binding on TAX-2?
key_finding: GO:0030553 cGMP binding on G5EEE2 is IBA only, from PANTHER PTN000025739
